reason: Card is about chlorine gas; EN reads 'dangerous to breathe in enclosed spaces' and BIS uses 'ginhawa' — 'hingin' (to ask for) cannot be the verb here.
Not a Filipino word; EN 'salt iodization is required under the ASIN Law' and BIS 'gikinahanglan kini' — 'sapat' would wrongly mean 'enough'.
EN 'What pulls you back down after jumping' and the card's own answer 'hinihila ka pababa ng grabidad'; 'bumabala' (warns) and 'bumababa' both fail before 'sa iyo pababa'.
Not a Filipino word; EN 'Their beautiful color and sparkle' — 'singaw' (vapour) is impossible for gemstones.
EN card: 'Detectors help prevent silent poisoning' — tagil is not a Tagalog root; the sentence needs Tumutulong, not tumatagal.
EN card calls polvoron 'crumbly' (bis: sayon muba); gunaw means cataclysmic destruction, so 'madaling madurog na pulbos' is the intended sense (matunaw would drift to 'melts').
EN/bis: ice changes directly 'into water vapor' (ngadto sa) — papaging is not a Tagalog word and palaging does not fit.
EN: 'Your microwave heats food' — needs Pinaiinit ng microwave ang pagkain; Paininit is not a valid form.
EN: 'at night, they shrink' (bis: mokunhod); umiit is not a word and uminit would contradict the day/night contrast with lumalawak.
not a Tagalog word; en says the coiled molecules 'uncoil when pulled' — nahahati (splits) would be factually wrong.

Should read 'Lihim bang kumukuha ng kuryente ang mga aparato?' (en 'secretly drinking power', bis 'Lihim ba nga nag-inom'); ninong (godfather) is stray.

EN: 'How does the heart pump blood?' and bis 'Unsaon pagpitik' (beat); pumipi (to flatten) is not a word for what a heart does — the card's own answer is piga/luwag, so pumipintig (or pumipiga) is meant. Note: the suggested neighbour pumili is NOT the fix.
Malformed reduplication (um-verb future of akit is aakit, not aaakit); with 'nito ... ang kidlat' the card needs object focus: 'Aakitin nito ang kidlat' (EN: 'It attracts lightning').

EN: 'ten reference minerals used to scratch and rank'; garapin is a one-off nonword (corpus 'garapon' = jar, 52x) — the Mohs kit scratches, so gasgasin. Note: the suggested neighbour garapon is NOT the fix.
'Paano nababao ang buong lechon sa uling' — nababao is not a Tagalog verb; EN asks how the lechon COOKS over charcoal (naluluto / naiihaw)
galap = to gather/recruit, impossible here; EN asks why carabaos WALLOW in mud (naglulublob/lumulublob sa putik)
i- plus -an is not a valid frame for palit; the answer says 'Nagpapalitan sila ng oxygen at carbon dioxide', so the question wants ipinagpapalitan (what is exchanged)
pumuo is not a Tagalog verb; blood that clots is 'dugong namumuo' (EN 'to make blood clot properly')
not a Tagalog word; the question is whether it can flood 'kahit hindi umuulan sa inyo' (EN 'even if it's not raining near you')
tanghal = to stage/present, impossible for a temperature inversion; EN says it TRAPS cold air and moisture
The card text is literally 'Naglala bas ang balat ng pawis' — one word split by a stray space; EN 'Your skin excretes sweat' = 'Naglalabas'.

kulong takes mag-/ma-/i-, not -um-, and 'don't imprison under a tree' is nonsense; three sibling lightning cards say 'Huwag sumilong sa ilalim ng puno' (EN 'never hide under a tall tree'). Near 'gumulong' is wrong.
'gaya' (imitate) is meaningless for the night sky and a boat; the card's own en says 'steer a boat' and bis 'maggiya sa sakayan', i.e. 'gumagabay sa bangka'.
'layag' (sail) makes no sense with 'Gaano ... lumutang ang cirrus clouds'; en reads 'How high do cirrus clouds float' and the card's own terms list has 'gaano kataas cirrus'.
The same sentence already says 'tuka at casque ng kalaw'; a hornbill has a casque, not a casket (en: 'a yellower casque').
